title: Implement Git soft-lease dual-runtime
description:
## Implementation

After protocol Gherkin is accepted: implement the Git lease provider in both Python and Rust against those scenarios. Claims are announced through the issue/event model. Timing must tolerate Git latency.

## Acceptance

Same Gherkin green on both runtimes. Git-only install has no MQTT or AWS dependency.
